about: The classic sliding-number puzzle: every swipe slides all tiles, equal tiles merge into their sum and a new tile appears. Make a 2048 tile, then keep going for a high score. Easy has a 5x5 board and unlimited undo, Normal 4x4 with 3 undos, Hard 4x4 with no undo and more 4s.
controls: Swipe anywhere on the board. Undo and New game buttons on the right. PC: arrow keys or WASD, U to undo.
tagline: Swipe to slide numbered tiles; equal tiles merge. Reach 2048.
